summary: Web backend D1 query and migration export profiles; actual definitions live in shared-cloud-schema.

key_files.app.schema.ts: Common cloud app tables plus Web-only runtime/session/chat tables, preserving the existing migration/query export profile.
key_files.better-auth.schema.ts: Compatibility export of canonical Better Auth tables and ORM relation metadata.
key_files.schema.ts: Existing app query profile consumed by drizzle.ts.
key_files.drizzle.ts: Cloudflare D1 adapter; no browser-owned persistence authority.
key_files.migrations.schema.ts: Existing Drizzle Kit profile: app tables and explicitly aliased Better Auth tables/relations. apps/web/drizzle.config.ts is the migration discovery entrypoint.

architecture_notes: Do not alter historical SQL to mirror source refactoring. No new SQL foreign keys; ORM relations remain valid query metadata.
